title: Exa Websets V2: Features, Pricing and Changes
summary: Exa websets v2 modifies the web search API's capabilities for automation teams. Learn which changes apply to your current workflows and automation setup.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Exa's pages settle the migration scope but leave four practical questions open, and wherever they say nothing, the answer below is "not stated" rather than a guess.


### Will existing v1 automations keep working?


Whether existing Exa Websets v1 automations keep working isn't stated. Nothing in the sources gathered here commits Exa to a v1 shutdown date or to indefinite support.


Until Exa publishes one, **treat any v1 workflow as unscheduled migration work** . Keep its call sites easy to find so the cutover is a small diff rather than a hunt.


### Can you verify v2 integration status?


Whether you can use Exa Websets v2 in Activepieces today isn't stated.


What is stated is how a connected integration behaves: register the HTTP integration once and it runs as a flow step and as a tool on the project's MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or an agent of your own can call your Exa request without a second integration or an export step.


The same integration action serves both, and you can confirm it in packages/integrations in the open source repo.


Check the integration's own action list against the v2 changes in your migration scope. If the field you need is missing, a raw HTTP request step to Exa's API is the fallback you can verify yourself.


### Where does Exa publish v2 pricing?


Where Exa publishes Websets v2 pricing isn't stated in the material reviewed. Pricing is the figure most likely to decide whether a workflow is worth running.


Read it from Exa's own pricing and documentation pages on the day you budget. Don't take it from a third-party summary, including this one.


### Has v2 integration support been tested?


Whether Activepieces tested Exa Websets v2 isn't stated. No test report or changelog entry confirming it appears in the sources.


**Treat v2 support there as unverified** until you've run one real workflow end to end.
